transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here for the term-sheet review on the $60 million consumer receivables securitization. Before I can sign off and issue the final term sheet, I need to follow our standard sign-off process. I'd like each of you — legal, credit risk, investor coverage, and loan operations — to state any conditions that must be reflected in the term sheet before I can approve the transaction. Please go ahead.

transcript.text: I received a legal memorandum this morning stating that counsel can deliver a true-sale opinion only if the receivables are transferred to a bankruptcy-remote special-purpose entity and the seller has no recourse for ordinary pool losses. This memorandum has not yet been attached to the term-sheet file. I need the term sheet to reflect these conditions before I can sign off on legal.
